newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 17.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government has taken steps to make automobile fuel lead-free as part of a four-point measure to check air pollution, Environment Minister Begum Sajeda Chowdhury said on Monday.
Syeed Eskander, brother of former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia, was granted on Monday anticipatory bail by the High Court in a criminal case for assaulting two intelligence officials.
Fire-fighting experts from Singapore and U.S.A. arrive on Tuesday to control the gas field fire in Moulavibazar.
Bangladesh ranks 144th among 175 countries in the Human Development Index (HDI).

Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) on Monday accused the government of failing to protect then national resources and dmanded probel by an international inquiry committee into the explosion of a gas field.
Pakistani Prime Minister Newaz Sharif and Indian Prime Minister I K Gujral are expected to visit Bangladesh in November this year.
The state-owned airlines, Bangladesh Biman, has raised fare by 15 percent in domestic routes.
European Union has agreed in principle to give derogation of Rules of Origin to Bangladesh in getting GSP in garment exports to EU countries from July under certain conditions. REUTER
